tasks.title: Implement read-only network inventory and Windows event sources
acceptance: Typed bounded event contracts
Connection inventory with clear collection scope
Event source health and permission failures are visible
No system-changing actions
tasks.notes: Network inventory provides local interface counters/rates and up to 256 TCP endpoints. Event monitor continuously samples 35 allow-listed v29 event IDs across 7 fixed Windows channels every 15 seconds, with metadata-only IPC, source health, filters and 4625 aggregation; source/docs pushed. Services route now has bounded SCM enumeration (512 services, 16 pages), query-only startup-type lookup, separate output-only IPC, schema validation, searchable WinUI list, and explicit partial/access-denied handling. No service management actions. Release build: 0 warnings/errors; full suite: 54 passed. Services slice pushed as 24aed93. Remaining event parity: PowerShell Sigma/AMSI analysis, richer detection, push subscriptions, alert lifecycle, Sysmon/ETW. See docs/WINDOWS_EVENTS.md.

tasks.title: Implement durable configuration, history, and migration-safe local storage
acceptance: Transactional schema upgrades
DPAPI-backed secrets

Privacy minimization
tasks.notes: Service-side SQLite operation journal schema v2 and recovery hardening pushed in ca38876. Includes v1 migration, service-account SID naming, state validation triggers, WAL activation check, strict generated object IDs, exact begin-intent retry binding, Failed/RecoveryRequired visibility, generic recovery-finalization denial, reparse-ancestor rejection and isolated ACL tests. Release build: 0 warnings/errors; 51 tests pass. Portable service remains the interactive-user account; journal is not tamper-proof and no action API/mutation exists. Remaining: retention, independent integrity evidence, backups, alert/evidence history, authenticated installed service identity and consent.

tasks.title: Implement audited response broker and reversible protection actions
acceptance: Explicit allow-list and authorization policy
Dry run and operator preview
Audit outcome and rollback
Denial, timeout, race, and recovery tests
Feature switches default off
tasks.notes: Critical prerequisite before any destructive/system-changing feature. Define a versioned narrow action catalog, policy validation, explicit per-action consent, default-deny, dry-run preview, idempotency, bounded execution, structured audit, cancellation/timeout, and recovery. First candidate: quarantine/restore with canonical path/file-handle and hash rechecks, encrypted staged copy, restrictive ACL, write-ahead manifest, atomic/copy-verify-delete, crash reconciliation, and exact-hash verified restore. No arbitrary shell/command execution.
